migration.name: 202610100004_l1_verification_challenges
migration.storage: Only HMAC-SHA256 of the recipient and of (challenge id + code) are stored; a database read recovers neither the address nor the code.
migration.guards: CHECK constraints for purpose, channel, hash shape, attempt bounds, expiry window and consumption ordering, plus a BEFORE UPDATE trigger that makes the binding immutable and lets attempts only rise and consumption happen once, and no-delete/no-truncate triggers.
migration.rollback: DROP TABLE "IdentityVerificationChallenge"; open challenges are lost, which only means the user requests a new code.

securityDecisions: The code is generated server-side with crypto.randomInt and delivered only through DevOutbox while no provider exists; production fails visibly with PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE rather than claiming a delivery.
The rider's client-supplied otp is ignored; a caller-chosen code would let anyone verify a target they do not control. The test asserts the delivered code differs from the client's.
A 30-second per-target cooldown matches the pinned screens' resend timer, on top of the shared per-caller Redis limits.
Only one challenge can be open per target and purpose: sending consumes any earlier open one in the same transaction.

commands.command: pnpm --filter @fairbite/api exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test/unit/identity/sendOtp.spec.ts
commands.detail: 2 tests: the adapter forwards the target (and the ignorable otp) for both send roots.

5 tests: exact web/app/rider documents; challenge row with 64-char hashes, VERIFY purpose, 10-minute expiry, zero attempts and no consumption; DevOutbox message with a 6-digit code; the rider's code never delivered; phone root over SMS; resend cooldown RATE_LIMITED with no second delivery; malformed targets rejected without any challenge or delivery.
21 files / 121 tests green on commit c20ddbd, including the populated migration-005 upgrade and fresh deploy.

evidenceStatus.reason: The apps list includes web, app and rider, so web (W16) and device (W19) evidence are genuinely owed. The record stays NOT_VERIFIED.

knownLimits: verifyOtp is not implemented yet, so a challenge cannot be consumed through the API in this commit; consumption semantics (expiry, attempt cap, single-use under concurrency) land with that root.
Account-level derivation from a consumed challenge (emailVerified/phoneVerified) is also still to come; until then the challenge is real server-side proof but no account flag is set from it.
